entry_sequence.transcript_quote: don't just you know map out any FVG on the chart map out the FVG that cost the break of structure the FVG that is very close to the order block
entry_sequence.action: Prefer the FVG that caused the break of structure and is very close to the order block.

entry_sequence.transcript_quote: patiently wait for you know price to get back into that FVG that caused the break of structure
entry_sequence.action: Wait for price to retrace back into the chosen FVG, then take the continuation entry from that retest in the trend direction.
entry_sequence.rationale: The entry is not on the impulse; it is on the return into the imbalance.
